frozen_scope.purpose: Classify why the frozen raw uncertainty gate fails on major development cells.
frozen_scope.sequence_position: AX4 after completed AX1, AX2, and AX3 and before conditional AX5

gate.name: raw
gate.source_rank_stabilizer_role: not evaluated by AX4; not retuned

ssr_sweep.purpose: Recreate the A12 fixed-threshold SSR development sweep.
ssr_sweep.sample_rule: reuse reproductions.ssr_prior_shift.protocol.stratified_frame_resample with the frozen A12 parameters

acoustic_cell.purpose: Recreate the A12 unmodified held-out acoustic cells.
acoustic_cell.pool_rule: test_mask and domain mask and condition equality; no resampling

taxonomy.taxonomy_failure_rule: A cell is a taxonomy failure if selected E[v] <= 0 or activation_rate > activation_warning_threshold.
taxonomy.focus_cell_source: The two point failures frozen by A12.
taxonomy.interpretation_limit: Point taxonomy is diagnostic only. No status authorizes changing the frozen gate, searching a new router, or opening A14.

bootstrap.primary_unit_rationale: Matches the frozen A12 source-level cluster bootstrap.
bootstrap.sensitivity_unit_rationale: Checks whether conclusions persist at the broader LibriSpeech speaker level.
bootstrap.resampling_rule: One shared cluster resample matrix is used for population and selected metrics within a cell.
bootstrap.finite_sample_rule: A bootstrap replicate with zero denominator is excluded only from that metric's interval.

assessment.interpretation: The frozen A12 failure cells have non-positive population and selected signed value. Long-context value is scarce in these conditions.
assessment.interpretation_limit: AX4 is diagnostic. Its point taxonomy does not authorize gate tuning, a new router, or opening A14.
